acceptance_criteria: 重複外部操作を起こさないか停止
scope: Through the MCP adapter, resending a recorded call with the same request_key after the reply was lost replays the stored result: one operation, history reserved -> leased_dispatch -> leased_completed, no second dispatch. An operation in the unknown state is never retried automatically. Real external services are not exercised. Status stays review: prerequisite gate.durable_operations.completed is open because it needs evidence from a real external service.
